{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CgRtp5gDckLsN8EKGEGrX","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-LoadCategories.md ===\n# FEATURE: Load Categories\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261027 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger load categories <csv>` as an all-or-nothing bulk load of categories. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-LoadAccounts.md, FEATURE-Validation.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | ledger load categories |\n| Consumes | ledger load accounts, ledgerlib.validation |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nLoad category records from a CSV file into the ledger. The whole file is accepted or none of it is stored.\n\n## Interface\n\n`ledger load categories <csv>` adds the `categories` handler to the per-table registry in `cli/commands/load.py` created by the accounts load story.\n\nOutput on success, as CSV with `\\n` endings:\n\n```text\ntable,loaded\ncategories,<rows>\n```\n\n## Behavior\n\n1. The file must be readable. An unreadable or missing file is an operational failure (exit 1, nothing on stdout).\n2. The header row must be exactly `category,description`. Any other header is rejected (exit 3).\n3. Every data row has the same field count as the header, else the file is rejected (exit 3).\n4. Each `category` is a code of 1 to 12 characters from `A-Z` and `0-9`. Each `description` is 1 to 40 characters with no comma or newline.\n5. A code repeated within the file, or already stored, is rejected (exit 3).\n6. Every check completes before the first write. Writes happen in one database transaction, so a rejected file stores nothing.\n7. A file with a valid header and no data rows loads zero rows, prints `categories,0` and exits 0.\n8. A missing path argument is a usage error (exit 2).\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- None — persistence is owned by DATABASE.md.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC load-categories-success ===\nIntent: A valid categories file loads in full, reports the row count, and every row reads back through the public store interface.\n\nimport csv\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef write_csv(directory, name, rows):\n    path = os.path.join(directory, name)\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n    return path\n\ndata = [[\"ZZLC1\", \"Load Cat One\"], [\"ZZLC2\", \"Load Cat Two\"], [\"ZZLC3\", \"Load Cat Three\"]]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:\n        path = write_csv(tmp, \"cats.csv\", [[\"category\", \"description\"]] + data)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", path)\n    print(out, err)\n    assert code == 0\n    parsed = list(csv.reader(out.splitlines()))\n    assert parsed == [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"categories\", str(len(data))]]\n    for cat, desc in data:\n        row = db.categories.get(category=cat)\n        assert row is not None\n        assert row.description == desc\n=== END AC load-categories-success ===\n\n=== AC load-categories-header-only ===\nIntent: A file with a valid header and no data rows loads zero rows and exits zero.\n\nimport csv\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:\n        path = os.path.join(tmp, \"empty.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n            csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerow([\"category\", \"description\"])\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", path)\n    print(out, err)\n    assert code == 0\n    parsed = list(csv.reader(out.splitlines()))\n    assert parsed == [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"categories\", \"0\"]]\n=== END AC load-categories-header-only ===\n\n=== AC load-categories-atomic-rejection ===\nIntent: A file whose last row has an invalid code is rejected with exit 3 and none of its valid earlier rows are stored.\n\nimport csv\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ngood = [[\"ZZLA1\", \"Atomic One\"], [\"ZZLA2\", \"Atomic Two\"]]\nbad = [\"zzbad\", \"Atomic Bad\"]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:\n        path = os.path.join(tmp, \"atomic.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n            w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n            w.writerow([\"category\", \"description\"])\n            w.writerows(good)\n            w.writerow(bad)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", path)\n    print(out, err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    for cat, _ in good:\n        assert db.categories.get(category=cat) is None\n=== END tmp:\n        path = os.path.join(tmp, \"hdr.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n            w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n            w.writerow([\"category\", \"desc\"])\n            w.writerow([cat, \"Header Test\"])\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", path)\n    print(out, err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert db.categories.get(category=cat) is None\n=== END AC load-categories-bad-header ===\n\n=== AC load-categories-field-count ===\nIntent: A data row whose field count differs from the header is = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n            w.writerow([\"category\", \"description\"])\n            w.writerow([first, \"Count One\"])\n            w.writerow([\"ZZLF2\"])\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", path)\n    print(out, err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert db.categories.get(category=first) is None\n=== END AC w.writerow([dup, \"First\"])\n            w.writerow([dup, \"Second\"])\n        code1, out1, err1 = cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", p1)\n        p2 = os.path.join(tmp, \"dup_stored.csv\")\n        with open(p2, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n            w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n            w.writerow([\"category\", \"description\"])\n            w.writerow([\"ZZLD3\", \"New One\"])\n            w.writerow([stored, \"Replacement\"])\n        code2, out2, err2 = cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", p2)\n    print(out1, err1, out2, err2)\n    assert code1 == 3\n    assert code2 == 3\n    assert out1 == \"\" and out2 == \"\"\n    assert db.categories.get(category=dup) is None\n    assert db.categories.get(category=\"ZZLD3\") is None\n    kept = none of the file's rows.\n- Application code does not read `sources/seed_categories.csv`; seed files reach the database only through `ledger load`.\n- Only the generated persistence package touches the database; no driver import in load code.\n- Diagnostics go to standard error and never to standard output.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-LoadTransactions.md ===\n# FEATURE: Load Transactions\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261027 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger load transactions <csv>` with whole-file validation and whole-file balance checking. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-LoadCategories.md, FEATURE-LedgerRules.md, FEATURE-Validation.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | ledger load transactions |\n| Consumes | ledger load categories, ledgerlib.rules, ledgerlib.validation |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nBulk load transactions, keeping each file's `txn_id`, so that either every row is stored or none is.\n\n## Interface\n\n`ledger load transactions <csv>` adds the `transactions` handler to `cli/commands/load.py`.\n\nOutput on success:\n\n```text\ntable,loaded\ntransactions,<rows>\n```\n\n## Behavior\n\n1. An unreadable file is exit 1 with nothing on stdout.\n2. The header must be exactly `txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo`, else exit 3.\n3. Each row has the header's field count, else exit 3.\n4. `txn_id` is a string of decimal digits; each row keeps its file `txn_id`. A `txn_id` repeated in the file or already stored is rejected (exit 3).\n5. `date` is a real calendar date `YYYY-MM-DD`. `amount` matches `-?DIGITS[.D[D]]`, at most two decimals, never zero, and is converted to integer cents with integer arithmetic. `memo` is 0 to 60 characters with no comma or newline.\n6. `account` must be stored and `category` must be stored, else exit 3.\n7. The balance rule is evaluated on each affected account's final balance after the whole file is applied on top of the stored transactions, not row by row. Any final balance below zero rejects the whole file (exit 3).\n8. Every check precedes the first write; writes happen in one database transaction. A rejected file changes nothing.\n9. A header-only file loads zero rows and prints `transactions,0`.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- None — persistence is owned by DATABASE.md.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC load-txn-success ===\nIntent: A valid file loads every row keeping its file txn_id, reports the count, and each row reads back with cents derived from the input text.\n\nimport csv\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"ZZLTA1\"\ncat = \"ZZLTC1\"\nrows = [\n    [\"880001\", \"2026-04-01\", acct, cat, \"100.00\", \"first\"],\n    [\"880002\", \"2026-04-02\", acct, cat, \"-30.25\", \"second\"],\n]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Load Txn A\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Load Txn Cat\")\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:\n        path = os.path.join(tmp, \"t.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n            w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n            w.writerow([\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"])\n            w.writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", path)\n    print(out, err)\n    assert code == 0\n    parsed = list(csv.reader(out.splitlines()))\n    assert parsed == [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"transactions\", str(len(rows))]]\n    for tid, date, a, c, amount, memo in rows:\n        row = db.transactions.get(txn_id=int(tid))\n        assert row is not None\n        assert row.date == date\n        assert row.account == a\n        assert row.category == c\n        assert row.amount == int(Decimal(amount) * 100)\n        assert row.memo == memo\n=== END AC load-txn-success ===\n\n=== AC load-txn-final-balance-rule ===\nIntent: The balance rule uses each account's balance after the whole file, so a withdrawal listed before the deposit that covers it is accepted.\n\nimport csv\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"ZZLTA2\"\ncat = \"ZZLTC2\"\nrows = [\n    [\"880011\", \"2026-04-01\", acct, cat, \"-50.00\", \"out first\"],\n    [\"880012\", \"2026-04-01\", acct, cat, \"100.00\", \"in second\"],\n]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Load Txn B\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Load Txn Cat2\")\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:\n        path = os.path.join(tmp, \"t.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n            w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n            w.writerow([\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"])\n            w.writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", path)\n    print(out, err)\n    assert code == 0\n    stored = db.transactions.list(account=acct)\n    assert sum(r.amount for r in stored) == sum(int(Decimal(r[4]) * 100) for r in rows)\n=== END AC load-txn-final-balance-rule ===\n\n=== AC load-txn-negative-final-balance ===\nIntent: A file that leaves an account below zero is rejected with exit 3 and none of its rows, including valid ones, are stored.\n\nimport csv\nimport os\nimport \"in\"],\n    [\"880022\", \"2026-04-02\", acct, cat, \"-20.00\", \"out\"],\n]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Load Txn C\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Load Txn Cat3\")\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:\n        path = os.path.join(tmp, \"t.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n            w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n            w.writerow([\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"])\n            w.writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", path)\n    print(out, err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    for r in rows:\n        assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=int(r[0])) is None\n=== END AC load-txn-negative-final-balance ===\n\n=== AC load-txn-stored-balance-counts ===\nIntent: The balance check includes already stored transactions, so a withdrawal exceeding the stored balance is rejected with exit 3 and the stored data is unchanged.\n\nimport csv\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Load Txn Cat4\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=stored_id, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=5000, memo=\"stored\"\n    )\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:\n        path = os.path.join(tmp, \"t.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n            w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n            w.writerow([\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"])\n            w.writerow([str(new_id), \"2026-04-02\", acct, cat, \"-60.00\", FEATURE-AccountAdd.md ===\n# FEATURE: Account Add\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261027 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger account add <code> <name>` creating a new account with a zero balance. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-LedgerRules.md, FEATURE-Validation.md, FEATURE-CsvOutput.md, FEATURE-LoadCategories.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | ledger account add |\n| Consumes | ledgerlib.rules, ledgerlib.validation, ledgerlib.csvout |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nAdd one account. This story creates `cli/commands/account.py` with the verb table that later account verbs extend.\n\n## Interface\n\n`ledger account add <code> <name>`. Output:\n\n```text\naccount,name,transactions,balance\n<code>,<name>,0,0.00\n```\n\n## Behavior\n\n1. `account` with an unknown verb, or `add` with other than exactly two arguments, is a usage error (exit 2).\n2. `code` is 1 to 12 characters from `A-Z` and `0-9`; `name` is 1 to 40 characters with no comma or newline. Violations exit 3.\n3. A code already stored is rejected (exit 3) and the stored account is unchanged.\n4. All checks precede the write. The printed row is read back from storage.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- None — persistence is owned by DATABASE.md.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC acct-add-success ===\nIntent: Adding an account prints the new row with zero transactions and balance 0.00, and the account reads back from the store.\n\nimport csv\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ncode_arg = \"ZZAA1\"\nname = \"Add Account One\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", code_arg, name)\n    print(out, err)\n    assert code == 0\n    parsed = list(csv.reader(out.splitlines()))\n    assert parsed[0] == [\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"]\n    assert parsed[1] == [code_arg, name, \"0\", \"0.00\"]\n    assert len(parsed) == 2\n    row = db.accounts.get(account=code_arg)\n    assert row is not None\n    assert row.name == name\n=== END AC acct-add-success ===\n\n=== AC acct-add-duplicate ===\nIntent: Adding a code that already exists exits 3 and leaves the stored name unchanged.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ncode_arg = \"ZZAA2\"\noriginal = \"Original Name\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=code_arg, name=original)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", code_arg, \"Other Name\")\n    print(out, err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    row = db.accounts.get(account=code_arg)\n    assert row is not None\n    assert row.name == original\n=== END AC acct-add-duplicate ===\n\n=== AC acct-add-invalid-code ===\nIntent: Codes that are lowercase, too long, contain a symbol, or are empty are rejected with exit 3 and nothing is stored.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nbad_codes = [\"zzlower\", \"Z\" * 13, \"ZZ-BAD\", \"\"]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    before = [r.account for r in db.accounts.list()]\n    for bad in bad_codes:\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", bad, \"Valid Name\")\n        print(repr(bad), code, out, err)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n    after = [r.account for r in db.accounts.list()]\n    assert after == before\n=== END AC acct-add-invalid-code ===\n\n=== AC acct-add-invalid-name ===\nIntent: Names that are empty, longer than 40 characters, or contain a comma or newline are rejected with exit 3 and the account is not created.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ncode_arg = \"ZZAA3\"\nbad_names = [\"\", \"n\" * 41, \"has, comma\", \"has\\nnewline\"]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    for bad in bad_names:\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", code_arg, bad)\n        print(repr(bad), code, out, err)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n        assert db.accounts.get(account=code_arg) is None\n=== END AC acct-add-invalid-name print(out, err)\n    assert code == 0\n    row = db.accounts.get(account=code_arg)\n    assert row is not None\n    assert row.name == name\n=== END AC acct-add-boundaries ===\n\n=== AC acct-add-usage  db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Get Cat\")\n    tid = 870001\n    for amount in amounts:\n        db.transactions.create(txn_id=tid, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=mine, category=cat, amount=amount, memo=\"m\")\n        tid += 1\n    for amount in other_amounts:\n        db.transactions.create(txn_id=tid, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=other, category=cat, amount=amount, memo=\"o\")\n        tid += 1\n    total = sum(amounts)\n    assert total >= 0\n    expected_balance = f\"{total // 100}.{total % 100:02d}\"\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-LoadCategories.md ===\n# FEATURE: Load Categories\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261027 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger load categories <csv>` as an all-or-nothing bulk load of categories. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-LoadAccounts.md, FEATURE-Validation.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | ledger load categories |\n| Consumes | ledger load accounts, ledgerlib.validation |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nLoad category records from a CSV file into the ledger. The whole file is accepted or none of it is stored.\n\n## Interface\n\n`ledger load categories <csv>` adds the `categories` handler to the per-table registry in `cli/commands/load.py` created by the accounts load story.\n\nOutput on success, as CSV with `\\n` endings:\n\n```text\ntable,loaded\ncategories,<rows>\n```\n\n## Behavior\n\n1. The file must be readable. An unreadable or missing file is an operational failure (exit 1, nothing on stdout).\n2. The header row must be exactly `category,description`. Any other header is rejected (exit 3).\n3. Every data row has the same field count as the header, else the file is rejected (exit 3).\n4. Each `category` is a code of 1 to 12 characters from `A-Z` and `0-9`. Each `description` is 1 to 40 characters with no comma or newline.\n5. A code repeated within the file, or already stored, is rejected (exit 3).\n6. Every check completes before the first write. Writes happen in one database transaction, so a rejected file stores nothing.\n7. A file with a valid header and no data rows loads zero rows, prints `categories,0` and exits 0.\n8. A missing path argument is a usage error (exit 2).\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- None — persistence is owned by DATABASE.md.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC load-categories-success ===\nIntent: A valid categories file loads in full, reports the row count, and every row reads back through the public store interface.\n\nimport csv\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef write_csv(directory, name, rows):\n    path = os.path.join(directory, name)\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n    return path\n\ndata = [[\"ZZLC1\", \"Load Cat One\"], [\"ZZLC2\", \"Load Cat Two\"], [\"ZZLC3\", \"Load Cat Three\"]]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:\n        path = write_csv(tmp, \"cats.csv\", [[\"category\", \"description\"]] + data)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", path)\n    print(out, err)\n    assert code == 0\n    parsed = list(csv.reader(out.splitlines()))\n    assert parsed == [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"categories\", str(len(data))]]\n    for cat, desc in data:\n        row = db.categories.get(category=cat)\n        assert row is not None\n        assert row.description == desc\n=== END AC load-categories-success ===\n\n=== AC newline=\"\") as fh:\n            csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerow([\"category\", \"description\"])\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", path)\n    print(out, err)\n    assert code == 0\n    parsed = list(csv.reader(out.splitlines()))\n    assert parsed == [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"categories\", \"0\"]]\n=== END AC load-categories-header-only ===\n\n=== Load Transactions\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261027 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger load transactions <csv>` with whole-file validation and whole-file balance checking. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-LoadCategories.md, FEATURE-LedgerRules.md, FEATURE-Validation.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | ledger load transactions |\n| Consumes | ledger load categories, ledgerlib.rules, ledgerlib.validation |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nBulk load transactions, keeping each file's `txn_id`, so that either every row is stored or none is.\n\n## Interface\n\n`ledger load transactions <csv>` adds the `transactions` handler to `cli/commands/load.py`.\n\nOutput on success:\n\n```text\ntable,loaded\ntransactions,<rows>\n```\n\n## Behavior\n\n1. An unreadable file is exit 1 with nothing on stdout.\n2. The header must be exactly `txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo`, else exit 3.\n3. Each row has the header's field count, else exit 3.\n4. `txn_id` is a string of decimal digits; each row keeps its file `txn_id`. A `txn_id` repeated in the file or already stored is rejected (exit 3).\n5. `date` is a real calendar date `YYYY-MM-DD`. `amount` matches `-?DIGITS[.D[D]]`, at most two decimals, never zero, and is converted to integer cents with integer arithmetic. `memo` is 0 to 60 characters with no comma or newline.\n6. `account` must be stored and `category` must be stored, else exit 3.\n7. The balance rule is evaluated on each affected account's final balance after the whole file is applied on top of the stored transactions, not row by row. Any final balance below zero rejects the whole file (exit 3).\n8. Every check precedes the first write; writes happen in one database transaction. A rejected file changes nothing.\n9. A header-only file loads zero rows and prints `transactions,0`.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- None — persistence is owned by DATABASE.md.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC load-txn-success ===\nIntent: A valid file loads every row keeping its file txn_id, reports the count, and each row reads back with cents derived from the input text.\n\nimport csv\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"ZZLTA1\"\ncat = \"ZZLTC1\"\nrows = [\n    [\"880001\", \"2026-04-01\", acct, cat, \"100.00\", \"first\"],\n    [\"880002\", \"2026-04-02\", acct, cat, \"-30.25\", \"second\"],\n]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Load Txn A\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Load Txn Cat\")\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:\n        path = os.path.join(tmp, \"t.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n            w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n            w.writerow([\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"])\n            w.writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", path)\n    print(out, err)\n    assert code == 0\n    parsed = list(csv.reader(out.splitlines()))\n    assert parsed == [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"transactions\", str(len(rows))]]\n    for tid, date, a, c, amount, memo in rows:\n        row = db.transactions.get(txn_id=int(tid))\n        assert row is not None\n        assert row.date == date\n        assert row.account == a\n        assert row.category == c\n        assert row.amount == int(Decimal(amount) * 100)\n        assert row.memo == memo\n=== END AC \"ZZLTC2\"\nrows = [\n    [\"880011\", \"2026-04-01\", acct, cat, \"-50.00\", \"out first\"],\n    [\"880012\", \"2026-04-01\", acct, cat, \"100.00\", \"in second\"],\n]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Load Txn B\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Load Txn Cat2\")\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:\n        path = os.path.join(tmp, \"t.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n            w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n            w.writerow([\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"])\n            w.writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", path)\n    print(out, err)\n    assert code == 0\n    stored = db.transactions.list(account=acct)\n    assert sum(r.amount for r in stored) == sum(int(Decimal(r[4]) * 100) for r in rows)\n=== END AC load-txn-final-balance-rule ===\n\n=== AC FEATURE-AccountAdd.md ===\n# FEATURE: Account Add\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261027 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger account add <code> <name>` creating a new account with a zero balance. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-LedgerRules.md, FEATURE-Validation.md, FEATURE-CsvOutput.md, FEATURE-LoadCategories.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | ledger account add |\n| Consumes | ledgerlib.rules, ledgerlib.validation, ledgerlib.csvout |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nAdd one account. This story creates `cli/commands/account.py` with the verb table that later account verbs extend.\n\n## Interface\n\n`ledger account add <code> <name>`. Output:\n\n```text\naccount,name,transactions,balance\n<code>,<name>,0,0.00\n```\n\n## Behavior\n\n1. `account` with an unknown verb, or `add` with other than exactly two arguments, is a usage error (exit 2).\n2. `code` is 1 to 12 characters from `A-Z` and `0-9`; `name` is 1 to 40 characters with no comma or newline. Violations exit 3.\n3. A code already stored is rejected (exit 3) and the stored account is unchanged.\n4. All checks precede the write. The printed row is read back from storage.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- None — persistence is owned by DATABASE.md.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC acct-add-success ===\nIntent: Adding an account prints the new row with zero transactions and balance 0.00, and the account reads back from the store.\n\nimport csv\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ncode_arg = \"ZZAA1\"\nname = \"Add Account One\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", code_arg, name)\n    print(out, err)\n    assert code == 0\n    parsed = list(csv.reader(out.splitlines()))\n    assert parsed[0] == [\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"]\n    assert parsed[1] == [code_arg, name, \"0\", \"0.00\"]\n    assert len(parsed) == 2\n    row = db.accounts.get(account=code_arg)\n    assert row is not None\n    assert row.name == name\n=== END AC acct-add-success ===\n\n=== AC acct-add-duplicate ===\nIntent: Adding a code that already exists exits 3 and leaves the stored name unchanged.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ncode_arg = \"ZZAA2\"\noriginal = \"Original Name\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=code_arg, name=original)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", code_arg, \"Other Name\")\n    print(out, err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    row = db.accounts.get(account=code_arg)\n    assert row is not None\n    assert row.name == original\n=== END AC acct-add-duplicate ===\n\n=== AC acct-add-invalid-code ===\nIntent: Codes that are lowercase, too long, contain a symbol, or are empty are rejected with exit 3 and nothing is stored.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nbad_codes = [\"zzlower\", \"Z\" * 13, \"ZZ-BAD\", \"\"]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    before = [r.account for r in db.accounts.list()]\n    for bad in bad_codes:\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", bad, \"Valid Name\")\n        print(repr(bad), code, out, err)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n    after = [r.account for r in db.accounts.list()]\n    assert after == before\n=== END AC acct-add-invalid-code ===\n\n=== AC acct-add-invalid-name ===\nIntent: Names that are empty, longer than 40 characters, or contain a comma or newline are rejected with exit 3 and the account is not created.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ncode_arg = \"ZZAA3\"\nbad_names = [\"\", \"n\" * 41, \"has, comma\", \"has\\nnewline\"]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    for bad in bad_names:\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", code_arg, bad)\n        print(repr(bad), code, out, err)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n        assert db.accounts.get(account=code_arg) is None\n=== END AC acct-add-invalid-name ===\n\n=== AC acct-add-boundaries ===\nIntent: A 12-character code and a 40-character name are the accepted maxima and are stored exactly.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ncode_arg = \"ZZ\" + \"B\" * 10\nname = \"n\" * 40\nwith db_session() as db:\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", code_arg, name)\n    print(out, err)\n    assert code == 0\n    row = db.accounts.get(account=code_arg)\n    assert row is not None\n    assert row.name == name\n=== END AC acct-add-boundaries ===\n\n=== AC acct-add-usage \"ZZAA4\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    attempts = [\n        (\"account\", \"add\"),\n        (\"account\", \"add\", code_arg),\n        (\"account\", \"add\", code_arg, \"Name\", \"extra\"),\n Busy\"\namounts = [12345, -2000, 500]\nother_amounts = [99999]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=mine, name=name)\n    db.accounts.create(account=other, name=\"Get Other\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Get Cat\")\n    tid = 870001\n    for amount in amounts:\n        db.transactions.create(txn_id=tid, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=mine, category=cat, amount=amount, memo=\"m\")\n        tid += 1\n    for amount in other_amounts:\n        db.transactions.create(txn_id=tid, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=other, category=cat, amount=amount, memo=\"o\")\n        tid += 1\n    total = sum(amounts)\n    assert total >= 0\n    expected_balance = f\"{total // 100}.{total % 100:02d}\"\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", mine)\n    print(out, err)\n    assert code == 0\n    parsed = list(csv.reader(out.splitlines()))\n    assert parsed[0] == [\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"]\n    assert parsed[1] db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Get Fresh\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Get Cat2\")\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=870011, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=1000, memo=\"a\")\n    code1, out1, err1 = cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", acct)\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=870012, date=\"2026-04-02\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=250, memo=\"b\")\n    code2, out2, err2 = cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", acct)\n    print(out1, err1, out2, err2)\n    assert code1 == 0 and code2 == 0\n    row1 = list(csv.reader(out1.splitlines()))[1]\n    row2 = list(csv.reader(out2.splitlines()))[1]\n    assert row1[2] == \"1\"\n    assert row2[2] == \"2\"\n    assert row1[3] != row2[3]\n=== END AC acct-get-reflects-changes ===\n\n=== AC acct-get-not-found ===\nIntent: An absent account code exits 4 with nothing on standard output.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom
